settings.heading: Join the House of Zaria
settings.body:
Zaria is a design-led couture house in Dubai, creating modest luxury with care and precision. We look for people who love craft, detail and quiet excellence, from pattern cutters and tailors to stylists, client advisors and digital talent.

If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you, even if there is no role listed today.

settings.title: Real craft
settings.text: Hands-on work with the finest fabrics and finishing.

settings.title: Room to grow
settings.text: A close-knit team where your work is seen and shapes the house.

settings.title: Considered pace
settings.text: Quality over volume, with time to do things properly.

settings.quote: Send your portfolio or CV to Order@zaria.ae. We read every message.
